0xe1c7392a.notice: Runs the EIP-712 + registry module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for an ERC-6538 stealth meta-address registry diamond — seeds the EIP-712 domain (name "ERC6538Registry" / version "1.0") the registry reuses for `registerKeysOnBehalf` signature hashing, then registers the IERC6538Registry interface (ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open). The registry facet itself carries the ERC-5267 `eip712Domain()` discovery entry point (it `is EIP712`), so no separate EIP712 facet is cut.
